short_description: Core StageKitWP plugin for seasons, shows, cast, awards, venues, board members, sponsors, contributors, testimonials, advertisers, and display options.
author: Huw Evans
name: stagekitwp-core

sections.description: The StageKitWP Core plugin provides the content management foundation for the full StageKitWP ecosystem, including custom post types, block support, admin hub screens, and the shared display options system.
sections.installation: Upload the stagekitwp-core plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/, activate it, and open the StageKitWP admin hub to begin managing content.
sections.changelog: 5.2.9: Landing Page (`[stagekitwp_landingpage]` + Show CPT front-end display) now supports an 'awards' field that lists the show's awards/nominations after the cast list (toggle via field_list attr or the Front-end Display meta box). Card and hero layouts also gain a second 'Get Tickets' button placed right after the performances list and before the venue.
